data.gender_notes: Georgeanna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Georgeanna is derived from the Greek name George, meaning farmer or earthworker, and Anna, meaning grace or favour. In the Bible, Saint George is known for his courage and faith. The name Georgeanna carries the meaning “George + Anna” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Georgeanna usually hope their child will grow to embody george + anna and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Georgeanna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “George + Anna.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Georgeanna total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: ג'ורג'נה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'ורג'נה - היא שם שמוצאו מן השפה הגאורגית, והוא נובע מהמילה הארמית 'ג'ורג', שמשמעותה 'גבר' או 'כוח'. התוספת של '-anna' (הבתולה) נובעת מהמילה היוונית 'חנה', שהפכה ל'אנה' בערבית. בביבליה, 'חנה' (אחותו של אברהם) הצעירה, נודעה גם כ'אנה' - 'הבתולה'.

in_greek.name: Γεωργιαννα
in_greek.long_meaning: Γεωργιαννα - Είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γεωργιανή γλώσσα και προέρχεται από τη λέξη Γεωργιανος (Γεωργιαν), η οποία σημαίνει 'γαιοκαλλιεργητής' ή 'γεωργός'. Η προσθήκη του -(α)ννα προέρχεται από τη λέξη αμίανθος (Αννα) που σημαίνει 'πurity' ή 'καθαρότητα'.

in_latin.name: Georgianna
in_latin.long_meaning: Georgianna - Est nomen quod originem habet a lingua Georgia et procedit a vocabulo Georgius (Georgius), qui significat 'cultor terrae' vel 'georgicus'. Additio -(a)nn(a) procedit a vocabulo Anna (Anna), quae significat 'purity' vel 'puritas'.

in_english.name: Georgeanna
in_english.long_meaning: Georgeanna - This name originates from the Georgian language and comes from the word 'George' (Georgian), meaning 'farmer' or 'earthworker'. The addition of '-Anna' comes from the word 'Anna' (the Virgin), which means 'purity' or 'virginity'.

The name Georgeanna is a reminder of the divine balance between strength and grace, and the importance of remaining grounded and connected to the Earth while also seeking the favor and guidance of God.
